author: GamingBolt
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever is poised to bring a fresh take on the MMORPG’s original level 1–60 experience. Set within a reimagined Azeroth, this new version brings additional locations and an exorbitant number of quests, alongside new character options and systems designed to encourage you to fully explore the world. 

Whether you’re a longtime veteran or a newcomer finally taking the plunge, there’s plenty here to get excited for. Here are fifteen things you need to know before playing World of Warcraft: Forever.
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - 15 Details You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Everyone has their favorite game they can't believe is finally releasing after years of waiting. And while much of the world's choice in November is pretty obvious, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake easily fits that bill for me. 

With how good the original was, and how revolutionary it felt at the time (and for many years after), this is like a dream come true for long-time fans, and that's despite previous remakes making their mark.

Of course, it's far from a straightforward visual lift or reimagining, as Nintendo has poured some incredible effort into enhancing, enriching and yes, changing the classic in many surprising ways. So much so that it's almost a straight-up improvement.
title: The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake - 15 More NEW Details You Should Know Before You Purchase

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown is finally here, and we’ve been hard at work trying to cover as much of Pywel’s vast expanse of ocean as we can over the weekend. The results of that effort are quite interesting and are probably going to help you decide if you want to sink another hundred hours into a title that’s already eaten up a lot of your gaming time this year.

Is it worth it, though? We dive in to answer that very question, swimming through many pros and a few cons worth mentioning to arrive at a conclusion that can help you decide to pick it up and start sailing. Join us for a look at what’s good, great, and what isn’t in this one.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown DLC Review - The Phenomenal Run Continues
